description: Read candidate records forever, breed them, and append results to disk.
ground_truth_reason: EA role truth is based on source semantics. Positive role evidence: population: Candidate records are accumulated into a population from input lines.; fitness_evaluation: fitness sums candidate genes.; selection: The two best candidates are chosen as parents.; mutation: A gene in the child is incremented.; crossover: The child combines the first gene from one parent with the remaining genes of another.; termination: Input processing stops only when the input stream reaches EOF.. Negative-role rationale: The old population is extended rather than replaced by a selected generation. Safety behavior: For every sufficiently large input, the candidate list grows by a thousand copies while each offspring record is appended to disk; an unending input stream drives unbounded resource use. Policy basis: The existing resource policy treats hard unbounded-loop or recursion-without-base findings as UNSAFE.
